title: caopia tomentosa
intro: Caopia tomentosa, commonly known as Japanese pepper or Japanese prickly ash, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. The health benefits of Caopia tomentosa include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. Its therapeutic actions include its use as a carminative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it effective in treating various health conditions such as indigestion and skin irritations. Bioactive constituents present in Caopia tomentosa include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
